mcp.addFile.message.defaultMessage: Adds {file} to the workspace (.hive/mcp){files, plural, =0 {} one {, with its file in a folder of its own} other {, with its # files in a folder of its own}}. Every project can turn it on in its MCP tab; it runs only where it is on. It runs:
mcp.addFile.message.description: Add MCP Server from File, above the command the server runs. {file} is the file added; {files} how many files a .zip brings. Keep .hive/mcp as it is.

mcp.addFile.replaceDetail.defaultMessage: Replace moves it (and the folder of one added from a .zip) to the Recycle Bin and adds this one, on only where you chose: projects that had the old one on lose it. Or choose another name.
mcp.addFile.replaceDetail.description: When a server of that name exists, under Replace or Choose Another Name.

mcp.addFile.turnOnFor.description: Add MCP Server from File: the label of the list of where to turn the server on.

mcp.allProjects.confirmButton.description: Button: turns the MCP server on in every project.

mcp.allProjects.confirmMessage.defaultMessage: New sessions in every project start it, except in projects that turned it off in their MCP tab. To use it in one project only, turn it on in that project's MCP tab instead. It runs:
mcp.allProjects.confirmMessage.description: The confirmation before an MCP server is turned on in every project. Followed by the command it runs.

mcp.allProjects.confirmTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before an MCP server is turned on in every project. {name} is the server.

mcp.error.fileChanged.defaultMessage: {file} has changed since it was shown to you. Add it again to see what it runs.
mcp.error.fileChanged.description: An error adding an MCP server from a file that changed after the add dialog showed it. {file} is the file name.

mcp.error.invalidName.description: An error: an MCP server name Hive refuses.

mcp.error.noServer.defaultMessage: The workspace has no MCP server named {name}.
mcp.error.noServer.description: An error turning a server on in a project. {name} is its name.

mcp.import.changed.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw it, so it was copied turned off: check what it runs and turn it on in the MCP tab.} other {{names} changed in the project's config after you saw them, so they were copied turned off: check what they run and turn them on in the MCP tab.}}
mcp.import.changed.description: After Copy to workspace, when servers changed between the confirmation and the copy. {names} lists them, {count} how many.

mcp.import.confirmButton.description: Button: copies the project's MCP servers to the workspace and turns them on in the project.

mcp.import.confirmMessage.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {It is turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn it on in their MCP tab. It runs:} other {They are turned on in {project} straight away; other projects can turn them on in their MCP tab. They run:}}
mcp.import.confirmMessage.description: Copy to workspace's confirmation, above what the servers run. {count} is how many; {project} the project they come from.

mcp.import.confirmTitle.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Copy {name} to the workspace?} other {Copy # MCP servers to the workspace?}}
mcp.import.confirmTitle.description: Title of Copy to workspace's confirmation. {count} servers a project defines in its own config; {name} the one when there is one.

mcp.import.on.description: After Copy to workspace: where the copied servers are on.

mcp.import.readFailed.description: An error's title: reading the MCP servers a project defines in its own config failed.

mcp.list.allOffTip.defaultMessage: Click to turn it on for all projects (new sessions). To use it in one project, turn it on in that project's MCP tab.
mcp.list.allOffTip.description: The tooltip of a server's switch in the MCP view while it isn't on for all projects.

mcp.list.allOnTip.defaultMessage: On for all projects (new sessions), except projects that turned it off. Click to turn it off for all projects: projects that turned it on themselves keep it.
mcp.list.allOnTip.description: The tooltip of a server's switch in the MCP view while it is on for all projects.

mcp.list.allSwitch.description: A server's switch in the MCP view, for screen readers. {name} is the server.

mcp.project.confirmButton.description: Button: turns the MCP server on in the project.

mcp.project.confirmMessage.defaultMessage: New sessions in {project} start it. It runs:
mcp.project.confirmMessage.description: The confirmation before an MCP server is turned on in a project. Followed by the command it runs.

mcp.project.confirmTitle.description: Title of the confirmation before an MCP server is turned on in one project (its MCP tab). {name} is the server, {project} the project.

mcp.project.updateFailed.description: An error's title: turning an MCP server on or off in a project failed.

mcp.tab.allBadge.description: A badge on a server in a project's MCP tab: it is on in every project unless one turns it off.

mcp.tab.hint.defaultMessage: Every MCP server in the workspace is available here: turn on the ones this project's agents need. A server on for all projects is on here unless you turn it off.
mcp.tab.hint.description: Under Workspace MCP servers in a project's MCP tab.

mcp.tab.projectDefined.defaultMessage: These servers are in the project's own agent config (such as .mcp.json). Hive starts sessions with only workspace servers, so they stay disabled until copied to the workspace, which turns them on here.
mcp.tab.projectDefined.description: Under Defined by the project in a project's MCP tab. Keep .mcp.json as it is.

mcp.tab.switch.description: A server's switch in a project's MCP tab, for screen readers. {name} is the server, {project} the project.

mcp.tab.workspaceBadge.description: A badge on a server in a project's MCP tab: it is one of the workspace's servers.

mcp.turnOn.all.description: A choice in Add MCP Server from File's Turn on for.

mcp.turnOn.none.description: A choice in Add MCP Server from File's Turn on for: on in no project until one turns it on.

mcp.turnOn.selected.description: A choice in Add MCP Server from File's Turn on for: the project selected in Hive. {project} is its name.

mcp.view.allProjects.description: Beside the switch in an MCP server's view that turns it on in every project.

mcp.where.all.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view.

mcp.where.allExcept.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view. {projects} lists the projects that turned it off.

mcp.where.none.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view: nowhere yet.

mcp.where.some.description: Where an MCP server is on, under it in the MCP view. {projects} lists the projects.
